entries.fright: Stunned 1 sec; roll vs. Will each sec to recover.
entries.awe: Stunned 1 sec; roll vs. Will each sec to recover.
entries.confusion: Stunned 1 sec; roll vs. IQ each sec to recover.

entries.fright: Stunned 1d–2d sec; roll vs. Will to recover.
entries.awe: Stunned 1d–2d sec; roll vs. Will to recover.
entries.confusion: Stunned 1d–2d sec; roll vs. IQ to recover.

entries.fright: Retching for (25 − HT) sec; roll vs. Will to recover.
entries.awe: Ecstasy for (25 − Will) sec; roll vs. Will to recover.
entries.confusion: Dazed for (25 − IQ) sec; roll vs. IQ to recover.

entries.fright: Acquire a quirk: mild phobia or superstition.
entries.awe: Acquire a quirk: fascination or devotion to the trigger.
entries.confusion: Acquire a quirk: persistent confusion or memory tic.

entries.fright: New −10 pt disadvantage: Delusion, Phobia, or Cowardice.
entries.awe: New −10 pt disadvantage: Fanaticism, Vow (worship), or Truthfulness.
entries.confusion: New −10 pt disadvantage: Indecisive, Confused, or Short Attention Span.

entries.fright: New −15 pt disadvantage: Severe Phobia or Paranoia.
entries.awe: New −15 pt disadvantage: Extreme Fanaticism or self-sacrificing Vow.
entries.confusion: New −15 pt disadvantage: Dementia (age-related confusion) or Deep Sleeper.

entries.fright: Major physical trauma: hair turns white, age 3d6 years, or lose 1 HT permanently.
entries.awe: Physical marking: faint glow, stigmata, or lose 1 HT from rapture.
entries.confusion: Brain fog: lose 1 IQ permanently; -2 to all skill rolls for 1d6 days.

entries.fright: Catatonia or coma for 1d6 days; lose 1d6 FP permanently.
entries.awe: Stupor of wonder for 1d6 days; lose touch with mundane reality.
entries.confusion: Fugue state for 1d6 days; cannot form new memories during episodes.

entries.fright: Permanent loss of −1 IQ and −1 Will from sheer horror.
entries.awe: Permanent loss of −1 IQ and −1 Per from overwhelming awe.
entries.confusion: Permanent loss of −1 IQ and −1 DX from fractured cognition.
